get.summary: Lists the media items of a website, newest first.

parameters.name: websiteId
parameters.description: The website whose media library is listed.

200.description: The website's media items, newest first.

post.summary: Uploads an image to a website's media library and creates its thumbnail.
post.description:
Accepts JPEG, PNG, GIF and WebP files up to 10 MB and 100 megapixels. The file's contents are checked
as well as its extension, so a file that is not really a supported image, or is damaged, is rejected.

201.description: The image was stored; the body is the new media item.

400.description: The file is missing, empty, too large, damaged, or not a supported image.

404.description: No website exists with the given id.

get.summary: Gets a single media item's details.

404.description: No media item exists with this id.

delete.summary: Deletes a media item together with its original image and thumbnail.

204.description: The media item and its files were deleted.

404.description: No media item exists with this id.

get.summary: Streams the original image as it was uploaded.
get.description: The response may be cached indefinitely, because a media item's files never change.

404.description: No media item or stored image exists with this id.

200.description: The original image (JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP).

get.description: The response may be cached indefinitely, because a media item's files never change.

404.description: No media item or stored thumbnail exists with this id.

get.summary: Gets a page's draft and published document.
get.description: A page without saved content gets an empty draft at revision 0 and no published version.

200.description: The page's draft and published document.

404.description: No page exists with this id.

put.summary: Replaces a page's draft. The Design Studio's autosave calls this.
put.description:
The document must be complete and pass the structural rules (block types, ranges, safe links, allowed rich text).
Saving a document identical to the current draft returns the same revision, so retries are harmless.

200.description: The draft was saved (or was already identical).

400.description: The document is malformed or breaks a structural rule.

404.description: No page exists with this id.

409.description: The draft was saved elsewhere since `baseRevision`; the body is the current content.

413.description: The request body is larger than 1 MB.

post.summary: Lists what to fix in a page's draft before it can be published.
post.description: Runs the same rules as publishing, without publishing. Errors block publishing; warnings don't.

200.description: The checked draft revision and its issues (empty when there is nothing to fix).

404.description: No page exists with this id.

post.summary: Publishes a page's draft: visitors see it from now on, and the page is marked published.
post.description:
Only the draft revision in the request is published, so nothing saved after the person chose Publish goes live
unseen. Drafts with error-level issues are refused with the issues; warnings don't block.

200.description: Published; the body is the page's content now.

404.description: No page exists with this id.

409.description: The draft is no longer at this revision; the body is the current content.

422.description: The draft has errors to fix first; the body lists all its issues.

get.summary: Lists the pages of a website, most recently updated first.

parameters.name: websiteId
parameters.description: The website whose pages are listed.

200.description: The website's pages, most recently updated first.

get.summary: Lists the installed plugins, including ones that couldn't be loaded and why.

200.description: The installed plugins; empty when there are none.

get.summary: Lists a plugin's recent runs, newest first, with what it logged and why a run failed.
get.description: Kept in memory: the last 25 runs per plugin since the API started.

200.description: The plugin's recent runs; empty when it hasn't run yet.

404.description: No plugin is installed with this id.

get.summary: Lists all websites, most recently updated first.

200.description: All websites, most recently updated first.

draftRevision.description: The draft revision that was checked.

issues.description: Errors first, then warnings, each in page order. Empty when there is nothing to fix.

ContentCheckDto.description: The content issues of a page's draft.

message.description: What is wrong, in plain language.

sectionId.description: The section it is in; null when it is about the whole page.

blockId.description: The block it is about; null when it is about a section or the page.

field.description: The block prop or section setting, e.g. `href` or `background.image`.

itemIndex.description: The item of a list prop (a gallery image, a menu link), when it is about one.

ContentIssueDto.description: A problem in a page's content that a person can fix.

websiteId.description: The website the media item belongs to.

fileName.description: The file name the image was uploaded with.

contentType.description: The original image's MIME type, for example `image/png`.

sizeInBytes.description: The original image's size in bytes.

width.description: The original image's width in pixels.

height.description: The original image's height in pixels.

imageUrl.description: Download route of the original image, relative to the API's base URL.

thumbnailUrl.description: Download route of the WebP thumbnail, relative to the API's base URL.

updatedAt.description: When the media item was last changed (UTC).

MediaItemDto.description: An image in a website's media library.

pageId.description: The page the content belongs to.

draft.description: The working draft. A page without saved content gets an empty document (no sections).

draftRevision.description: The draft's revision: send it back as `baseRevision` when saving. 0 when nothing was saved yet.

draftUpdatedAt.description: When the draft last changed (UTC); null when nothing was saved yet.

oneOf.description: What visitors see; null when the page was never published.

publishedAt.description: When the page was last published (UTC); null when never.

hasUnpublishedChanges.description: True when there is no published version or it differs from the draft.

PageContentDto.description: A page's draft and published Design Studio document.

version.description: The plugin's version; null when its manifest couldn't be read.

events.description: The events it runs for, e.g. `page.published` or the `page.check` hook.

loaded.description: False when it couldn't be loaded; it isn't run then.

moduleSha256.description: SHA-256 of its WebAssembly module, to tell builds apart.

eventId.description: The event's id; plugins that ran for the same event share it.

succeeded.description: False when it crashed, hit a sandbox limit or returned bad output.

durationMs.description: How long it took, in milliseconds.

fuelConsumed.description: Roughly how many WebAssembly instructions it ran.

droppedLogLines.description: Lines it logged past the limit.

revision.description: The draft revision the person saw when they chose Publish.

issues.description: All issues of the draft, errors first; at least one is an error.

revision.description: The draft's revision now: send it as `baseRevision` with the next save. Unchanged when the document was identical.

hasUnpublishedChanges.description: True when there is no published version or it differs from the draft.

SavedDraftDto.description: The result of saving a draft.

document.description: The complete draft document, as the studio normalised it.

baseRevision.description: The draft revision this document was edited from (`draftRevision` from the last load or save); 0 when no draft was saved yet.

SaveDraftRequest.description: A new draft for a page.
